name: Merciless Tang
description: Open with a cut that sets the guard and the return line at once.

name: Unconquered Fuller
description: Hold the sword in a paired guard with qi in both the high and the low line.

name: Phantom Feint
description: Advance in the measured two-step of the court so that cut and guard stay joined.

name: Chimefuller
description: Parry a cut and return the same cut along the foe's own line.

name: Overpowering Midrib
description: Bind the foe's sword between the swordsman's own two edges with field qi.

name: Tempered Riposte
description: Run a chain of paired cuts, the first opening and the second landing.

name: Granite Foible
description: Sweep the blade through both courts of the guard, cutting every foe in the arc.

name: Crossbar Valor
description: Cover both lines with qi so that a blow on one side comes back on the other.

name: Tempered Pommel
description: Close the court with a single thrust the foe cannot guard, because both guards were already spent.

name: Tempered Ricasso
description: Cut with a wide opening of both arms like a hawk spreading its wings.

name: Aegis Forte
description: Hold the sword high with qi spread above the head like the open sky.

name: Hollowfeint
description: Fix the point on a single spot and thrust the instant the foe's guard shifts.

name: Glissade Slipstream
description: Drop and rise with a light springing step ready to stoop or climb.

name: Forte Durance
description: Rise into a parry that lifts the foe's blade clear of the body.

name: Mayhem Quillon
description: Beat down the foe's blade from above with a pulse of qi in the edge.

name: Tempered Envelop
description: Stoop again and again in a chain of falling cuts that gain force.

name: Ironleaf
description: Gather qi in the point, rise on a long breath, and dive onto the foe with a single piercing thrust.

name: Unassailable Leaf
description: Hold the high guard so a cut struck against it rebounds to its sender.

name: Phantom Quillon Blink
description: Vanish upward from the foe's sight and drop at his flank with the edge already cutting.

name: Brutalizing Cutover
description: Cut along the first track with the guard track held ready.

name: Pommel Obduracy
description: Hold the second track as a guard while the first track strikes.

name: Crossbar Reckoning
description: Join both tracks in a single thrust that leaves no guard open.

name: Torrent Foible
description: Step along one fork of the track and then the other to unsettle the foe.

name: Midribscourge
description: Cut in a basin-like curve that draws the foe's guard inward.

name: Equipoise Fuller
description: Swap tracks mid-parry so the foe's cut meets the second track's guard.

name: Strangling Glissade
description: Press the foe with both tracks at once so that he must give ground.

name: Sanguine Beat
description: Join a rising edge from one track with a falling edge from the other.

name: Lacerating Tang
description: Send a joined wave of qi from the blade along both tracks to strike at a distance.

name: Glintmidrib
description: Cover both tracks with qi so every blow is returned along its own line.

name: Might Leaf
description: Gather both tracks into a single cut at a moment the foe cannot meet either.

name: Ricasso Wrath
description: Rise from a deep stance into a cut with qi gathered low in the hips.

name: Charter Forte
description: Settle into a deep stance with qi pooled low and the blade held steady.

name: Decimating Beat
description: Thrust beneath the foe's guard with the point following the low river of qi.

name: Ghosting Riposte
description: Settle onto the lead foot with each pace so that the stance grows deeper as it advances.

name: Gustpommel
description: Turn aside a cut with a calm parry that gives and returns like still water.

name: Merciless Feint
description: Pour the qi gathered in the stance down the blade in a single heavy cut.

name: Overpowering Ricasso
description: Pull the foe's sword down and aside in a bind like a river current.

name: Toxin Cutover
description: Beat the foe's blade with qi rising from the low stance.

name: Tempered Feint
description: Slice around the rim of the foe's guard with the edge following a curved path.

name: Siltpommel
description: Release the pooled qi at once in a wide low sweep of the edge.

name: Unassailable Foible
description: Hold the basin guard so blows enter and return along the river's line.

name: Crushing Envelop
description: Drive the point down with the whole depth of the basin's qi through the foe's defence.

name: Shattering Crossbar
description: Dive onto the foe with a quick cut and rise before he answers.

name: Evergreen Quillon
description: Hold a guard that flows round each blow like a river round a stone.

name: Facetforte
description: Thrust with a long running stride that carries the point across a wide gap.

name: Dazzling Tang
description: Land on one foot like a perched hawk and hold still before the next move.

name: Pommelvalor
description: Receive a cut on the flat and let it run along the blade like water along a bank.

name: Blaze Leaf
description: Link stoops and flowing cuts in a long chain that never stops moving.

name: Midribnerve
description: Close the quillons on the foe's blade like claws and hold it still.

name: Feintmettle
description: Draw the foe's blade along the flat in a long pull that tears it from his hand.

name: Pommel Havoc
description: Cut from a height like a river falling over a ledge.

name: Tangscourge
description: Sweep the blade in a wide arc that dives and rises like a hawk over water.

name: Ponderous Riposte
description: Hold the point at the foe's face in a stare that pins him in place.

name: Nova Beat
description: Gather qi in a long arc and send a flowing blade wave that cuts at a distance.

name: Glintpommel
description: Cross the gap to the foe in an instant and cut with the edge at his flank.

name: Rumble Glissade
description: Cut from a paired guard that also covers the line of the return.

name: Midribvalor
description: Hold a stooping guard with the blade angled and qi gathered above.

name: Rumble Fuller
description: Thrust twice on the same line, the second behind the first.

name: Phantom Midrib
description: Move two paces as one so the sword advances in a continuous line.

name: Unsparing Envelop
description: Parry then stoop onto the foe's blade and cut through the opening.

name: Gyve Foible
description: Bind the foe's blade with both the guard and the stoop in one hold.

name: Chime Glissade
description: Beat the foe's blade twice in rapid succession and break his hold.

name: Facet Midrib
description: Cover the body with the paired guard and return each blow.

name: Granite Leaf
description: Stoop low with the edge following round to sweep every enemy within the circling cut.

name: Tempered Quillon
description: Finish a guard exchange with a stoop whose double thrust cannot be parried by the paired guard.

name: Sanguine Pommel
description: Cut down from the high guard with the sky behind the edge.

name: Indomitable Fuller
description: Hold the sword up and open so qi can spread above and around.

name: Fullerscourge
description: Drive the point straight down the line from a high stance.

name: Silt Cutover
description: Rise on the toes and advance with a light springing pace.

name: Adamantine Crossbar
description: Beat aside a cut with a sweeping upward stroke like a wing.

name: Envelop Reckoning
description: Chain cuts downward from the high guard, each cut falling from higher.

name: Gyve Forte
description: Raise the foe's blade into the high guard and lock it with qi.

name: Toxin Tang
description: Beat the foe's blade out and down from a high stance.

name: Chimebeat
description: Send a falling crescent of qi from the edge as the cut descends.

name: Pommelspine
description: Cover the head and shoulders with a high guard that sends blows back.

name: Gnashing Blaze Midrib
description: Raise the blade slowly, gathering qi, then bring it down in one cut that breaks the foe's guard.

name: Rumbleleaf
description: Open with a long cut along the first track while the second waits.

name: Impervious Ricasso
description: Hold the guard along the second track with steady qi.

name: Novaforte
description: Thrust along the long track from a deep lunge.

name: Foiblenerve
description: Parry on the second track and return along the first.

name: Mastering Beat
description: Bind the foe's blade at the reach of the sword and hold it.

name: Mastering Riposte
description: Beat the foe's blade on one track then the other.

name: Glissade Scourge
description: Sweep both tracks in a wide arc that reaches all foes at the sword's measure.

name: Glint Quillon
description: Cover both tracks and send each blow back along its own line.

name: Beathavoc
description: Pull both tracks together into one cut that reaches beyond the blade's length.

name: Rumble Cutover
description: Open with a cut like the first gust, wide and full of force.

name: Unassailable Ricasso
description: Hold the blade open and sworn to its line, giving no ground to the cut.

name: Eviscerating Cutover
description: Thrust with a sudden fall of the weight like a gust dropping from the plateau.

name: Tangblink
description: Run forward in long strides across open ground with the blade level.

name: Mayhem Foible
description: Beat aside the foe's blade and step into the line.

name: Gustmidrib
description: Sweep the foe's cut wide with a long parry like a gust through a field.

name: Tempered Beat
description: Chain cuts without retreat so the foe never finds a gap.

name: Mayhempommel
description: Sweep the blade in a great flat arc as a gale sweeps the plateau.

name: Glamour Midrib
description: Hold the open guard so the gale of a returning blow strikes the foe.

name: Lightning Tang
description: Cross the plateau in a gust-quick rush and cut in the same motion.

name: Granite Crossbar
description: Cut with the gale behind the edge from a stance at the open rim.

name: Fortespine
description: Hold the guard at the plateau rim with qi spread wide.

name: Hollowforte
description: Thrust along the line of the wind with a long reaching arm.

name: Torrent Leaf
description: Move along the rim in short balanced steps that never lose the line.

name: Pommeldurance
description: Press the foe's blade and hold it with qi as steadily as the wind.

name: Torrent Forte
description: Turn the blade and let the foe's cut slide off like wind round a cliff.

name: Blazeforte
description: Chain wide cuts across open ground without lowering the guard.

name: Chime Pommel
description: Send a long crescent of qi from the edge that carries across open ground.

name: Impervious Leaf
description: Hold the open rim guard so a blow struck against it comes back.

name: Unsparing Gust Riposte
description: Gather the gale into the point of the blade and cut as it breaks.

name: Eviscerating Fuller
description: Take a bearing and cut along it in a single sworn stroke.

name: Thorn Pommel
description: Hold the blade on its bearing so that the foe must go round it.

name: Rumbleforte
description: Thrust along the held bearing without letting the line waver.

name: Granite Midrib
description: Walk the bearing toward the foe in steady steps.

name: Equipoise Foible
description: Parry by checking the foe's blade in the direction of the wind.

name: Mightmidrib
description: Turn the bearing in mid-cut and strike from a new angle.

name: Gyve Envelop
description: Bind the foe's blade and hold the bearing until he gives way.

name: Mayhem Beat
description: Beat the foe's blade off its bearing and take the line.

name: Beatruin
description: Slip the edge past the guard on a bearing the foe cannot read.

name: Ferocious Cutover
description: Hold the bearing on the foe until he cannot move without opening his guard.

name: Mangling Forte
description: Send a thin line of qi from the edge along the bearing to reach a distant foe.

name: Booming Nova Envelop
description: Take the final bearing and thrust in one sworn motion that holds to the end.

name: Sanguine Feint
description: Cut along a bearing taken from beyond the foe's reach.

name: Charter Tang
description: Hold the bearing line before the body with qi steady along the blade.

name: Riposte Scourge
description: Thrust the full length of the line from a deep lunge.

name: Midribvortex
description: Cross a long gap in a few paces that keep the blade on its bearing.

name: Torrent Fuller
description: Turn aside a cut while the point holds the line to the foe's throat.

name: Gustbeat
description: Draw the edge along the foe's blade from the bearing and cut the hand.

name: Intent Ricasso
description: Press down the foe's blade with steady qi and hold it there.

name: Rampaging Glissade
description: Sweep the long line of the blade in a wide arc across all enemies near.

name: Glamour Quillon
description: Hold the line firmly so a cut against it rebounds.

name: Midribblink
description: Move through the foe's guard along the bearing as though it were not there and cut behind.

name: Corroding Envelop
description: Cut in a wide sweep that leaves no part of the body covered.

name: Hoarfrost Foible
description: Stand without cover and hold the open line with qi along the blade.

name: Novamidrib
description: Thrust bare along the open line with no guard held back.

name: Silt Leaf
description: Stride across open ground in long steps that cover the gap in a breath.

name: Chime Feint
description: Beat the foe's blade off the open line and enter.

name: Flintlike Ricasso
description: Bend the parry with the wind and let the foe's cut pass.

name: Ironpommel
description: Chain cuts that never close the guard and keep the foe moving back.

name: Nova Pommel
description: Send a broad crescent of qi from the edge that crosses open ground.

name: Crossbar Durance
description: Hold the open stance and return each blow along its own line.

name: Glint Feint
description: Strike the foe's chest in a thrust that opens his guard like a rampart breached.

name: Mightfeint
description: Cut from the windward side with the force behind the edge.

name: Tangmettle
description: Hold the sworn stance with the blade steady before the chest.

name: Ruinous Crossbar
description: Thrust along the sworn line with the point fixed.

name: Silt Quillon
description: Pace steadily across ground with the blade level and the stance wide.

name: Torrent Tang
description: Turn the parry on the sworn line and cut back at once.

name: Gyvetang
description: Bind the foe's sword upwind and hold it.

name: Mayhemfeint
description: Beat the foe's blade down on a sworn line.

name: Sanguine Midrib
description: Chain cuts from the same side without breaking the line.

name: Riposte Devastation
description: Cut a wide flat arc from the windward side that forces the foe back.

name: Glamour Forte
description: Hold the sworn guard so each blow returns to its sender.

name: Devastating Glissade
description: Hold the point on the foe's centre until he cannot advance.

name: Tempered Cutover
description: Finish the exchange with one cut sworn to the windward line that nothing breaks.

name: Vengeful Feint
description: Take a bearing and cut along it with the force of a sudden gust.

name: Unrelenting Fuller
description: Hold the guard steady in the face of the foe's cut as against a gale.

name: Glint Beat
description: Thrust along the bearing with the weight of the gale behind the body.

name: Unseen Forte
description: Surge forward in a quick step like a gust and pause.

name: Equipoise Pommel
description: Check the foe's blade on its bearing and turn it.

name: Overpowering Tang
description: Hold the foe's sword in a bind steady as a gale.

name: Mangling Beat
description: Slip the edge past the guard on a new bearing.

name: Facet Feint
description: Send a hard crescent of qi from the edge along the bearing.

name: Siltfuller
description: Sweep the edge in a great arc that hits everything within the blade's reach.

name: Grievous Riposte
description: Hold a breath and release the whole gale into the edge in one cut along the bearing.

name: Granite Quillon
description: Cut at the limit of the sword's reach with the sworn line held.

name: Facet Crossbar
description: Hold the blade open in the wind with qi steady along it.

name: Lacerating Cutover
description: Thrust at the limit of reach with the arm fully extended.

name: Unrelenting Ricasso
description: Turn a cut aside at the end of the foe's reach and strike back.

name: Thornfeint
description: Bind the foe's blade at the limit of reach.

name: Hogtying Midrib
description: Beat the foe's blade off the sworn line and step in.

name: Blaze Glissade
description: Sweep the blade at the limit of its reach across all foes near.

name: Waning Fuller
description: Hold the wind guard so blows return to the foe.

name: Hellish Leaf
description: Gather the wind to the point of the sword and cut beyond the blade's length.
